TITLE: Park+Fly Eindhoven

Our routes
Park+Fly Eindhoven
Park+Fly Eindhoven
Park+Fly Eindhoven offers low-cost indoor parking and a bus service to Eindhoven Airport. This is a collaboration between P1 and Hermes.
This is how it works
Purchase a parking ticket.
Park your car at Park+Fly Terminal M.  Your license plate is automatically recognized.
Walk to the Meerrijk bus stop, about 150 metre from Q-Park Meerhoven.
Take 401. During the day this bus runs from Meerrijk every 10 to 15 minutes and brings you to Eindhoven Airport within 8 minutes free of charge when you show your parking ticket.
Park+Fly Terminal M
Park+Fly Terminal M
is located in Meerhoven shopping mall, at the Grasbaan in Eindhoven. The parking garage has 1,736 parking spots.
Address:
Meerzand 1, 5658 LJ Eindhoven
Order your ticket in advance
By buying a combined ticket for parking and bus in advance, you can be assured of a good parking spot near Eindhoven Airport from as little as €3.52 a day.
Order
Related
Airport Shuttle Eindhoven
The Airport Shuttle is a direct bus connection between the airport and Eindhoven Station.
